chapters.text: Tomorrow you're off to see the family for Christmas. A packed station, a long queue, presents in both arms. So tonight you pack the bag the smart way, one thing in each place, and an easy walk through the gate tomorrow.
Cards and cash go in the hidden pocket on the back. It sits flat against you, so in a crowd nobody behind you can reach them. Phone and keys go in the two gold side zips, one on each side.
Everything else goes inside, where divided compartments keep it from sinking to the bottom. Then one pull on the zip, and the whole bag is shut for the night.
Morning. Coat on, bag on your shoulder, presents in your hands. At the ticket gate your card is right there in the back pocket, and your phone is one side zip away.

chapters.text: POV: it's the last Saturday before Christmas, and the high street is packed. Your list is long, your arms are already full, and the bag on your shoulder keeps slipping off. Sound familiar?
So you clip on the long strap and wear it crossbody. Two straps come in the box, one long, one short. Now both hands are back, and the bag sits in front of you where you can see it.
At the till, your card is in the hidden back pocket, flat against you. Out, tap, back in, and the queue keeps moving. No digging, and no putting the shopping down on the counter.
Later, dinner out. Swap to the short strap and it's a handbag on the chair beside you, in soft leather that looks expensive. Same bag, three ways to wear it, all in one day.
